readiness.hed: A chance of rain showers lingers into tonight, then skies clear and turn colder and breezier for Friday into the weekend
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service has no active alerts for Fredericksburg. This afternoon stays mostly cloudy with temperatures falling from near 67 toward 61 as a 30 percent chance of rain showers moves through, continuing as a 20 percent slight chance tonight before 7 p.m. with a low around 44. Friday turns partly sunny but breezier and colder, with a high near 52 and north wind gusts up to 24 mph, then Friday night drops to a low around 33. Saturday stays mostly sunny near 52 with gusts to 23 mph, falling to a low around 32 Saturday night.
actions: Keep a rain layer handy this afternoon and early tonight; totals stay under a tenth of an inch.
Friday's gusts could reach 24 mph — secure light outdoor items before the wind picks up.
Protect sensitive plants and exposed pipes Friday night and Saturday night as lows drop into the low 30s.
Temperatures fall roughly 15 degrees from this afternoon's high to tonight's low — dress layers accordingly for evening activities.
